recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a mobile portrait browser game titled **Ember & Lumo: Memory Road**. Preserve the mechanics of a one-finger horizontal endless collection runner: the hero follows touch X, collectibles spawn from three lanes and scroll downward, overlap collects them, unique IDs increase a 500-item collection score, fuel steadily drains, new pickups restore more fuel than duplicates, and empty fuel triggers game over with restart.

Present the game as a Pixar-style emotional adventure: soft cinematic sky, warm peach/gold/rose color storytelling, expressive rounded characters, heartwarming comedy, family scrapbook language, and a clear focal duo named Ember and Lumo. Use browser-native Canvas/CSS/JS in one self-contained index.html. Make mobile HUD labels large and truthful: Heartglow, Memory Cast, Family Camp, New Adventure, Try Again.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source game truth
The source is a mobile canvas endless-collection runner. A hero sits near the bottom of a portrait playfield and follows pointer X input. Collectible entities spawn in three lanes, scroll downward, and are collected when their bounds overlap the hero. Fuel drains over time, collection contact restores fuel, new IDs are saved in localStorage, the score is the Set size out of 500, and fuel depletion enters game over. Menu, index, pause, restart, reactions, audio, haptics, and particle feedback are present.

## Protected mechanics
- Pointer/touch horizontal steering and smoothing.
- Canvas render/update loop with dt cap.
- Three-lane spawn positions, rarity ranges/probability pattern, 500 collection IDs.
- Fuel drain rate, +30 new/+15 duplicate fuel restore, game-over at zero.
- Collision threshold based on hero/entity width and height.
- Pause, index, restart, and persistent collection semantics.

## Transformable surfaces
Visual identity, naming, HUD copy, color palette, procedural backgrounds, entity silhouettes, audio mood, toast text, menu/index copy, and particles are themable and were rebuilt.

## Remix target
Ember & Lumo: Memory Road transforms the collector runner into a Pixar-inspired emotional road adventure about gathering runaway feeling sparks into a family scrapbook while preserving the underlying arcade collection mechanics.
